issues.description: Full test suite fails with exit code 1. Runtime parity check shows 2 failures in tests/test_v1_scenario_matrix.py (TestMalformedDrop, TestUnrecognisedSourceDrop) when run as part of the full suite, despite passing 21/21 in isolation.
issues.requirement: AC-010: Full suite green via `.venv/bin/python -m pytest` from the jarvis repo root
issues.suggestion: Three resolution paths: (1) Prove these failures exist on the baseline branch before your changes - run `git stash && pytest tests/test_v1_scenario_matrix.py` to demonstrate pre-existing pollution, then update AC-010 to exclude pre-existing failures; (2) Fix the structlog state isolation issue you diagnosed - ensure each test properly resets structlog configuration in setup/teardown; (3) Add pytest fixtures to isolate these tests from suite-wide pollution (e.g., autouse fixtures that reset global state).

criteria_verification.notes: All 20 scenario test classes implemented and confirmed by independent test collection showing 21 items (20 scenarios + 1 count assertion test). Class names mirror scenario names as required.

Evidence shows _make_subscriber() creates real ForgeNotificationsSubscriber and SlackNotifier instances, mocking only AsyncWebClient.chat_postMessage. Tests call real _handle_message() with synthetic MessageEnvelope bytes.
No .feature files, no pytest-bdd imports, header explicitly states 'Plain pytest ONLY'. Verified by evidence bundle.
TestCollectOnlyCountAssertion implements test_collect_only_count_matches_expected() asserting >=21 tests. Independent test run confirms 21 items collected. Collection regression protection in place.
TestMalformedDrop and TestUnrecognisedSourceDrop both implemented, testing drop with WARNING log and zero Slack calls without raising. Tests pass in isolation per independent_tests evidence.
TestDeliveryFailureOutcomePreservation verifies DDR-007 contract: SlackApiError caught, logged, message dropped, _handle_message completes without exception. Outcome preservation confirmed.
TestDuplicateTerminalDedup tests first-wins 300s TTL with structlog capture confirming 'slack_notify_dropped_duplicate' debug log on second delivery. Dedup semantics verified.
TestThrottlingBurst tests 429 Retry-After handling with burst of 3 notifications. Worker honours retry delay confirmed. Overflow drop covered by existing SlackNotifier tests.
TestNoReplayOnRestart tests two lifecycles: first sends notification, then rebuilds subscriber/notifier and verifies no additional calls. In-memory DDR-027 posture confirmed.

Runtime parity check definitively shows full suite exit code 1 (failure). While matrix tests pass 21/21 in isolation, the full suite has 2 failures. Player claims pre-existing pollution but provides no baseline comparison. AC-010 requires full suite green - not achieved.

rationale: Outstanding work on 9/10 acceptance criteria with honest reporting and well-architected tests. However, AC-010 explicitly requires 'Full suite green' and runtime_parity evidence shows exit_code=1. The claim of pre-existing pollution needs proof (baseline comparison) or the pollution needs to be fixed. Matrix tests are fundamentally sound (21/21 pass in isolation), so this is a test isolation issue rather than a correctness problem. Provide evidence of baseline state or fix the structlog isolation to achieve full suite green.
